title: UL-04 — Challenge: Customer-managed KMS key
scenario: Extend GL-04 with an explicit CMK key policy, one Secrets Manager secret, and one SSM standard parameter—then delete billable extras before finishing KMS teardown.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul04`: key alias `alias/workbook-ul04`, secret `workbook-ul04-secret`, SSM parameter `workbook-ul04-param`, and bucket `workbook-ul04-<account-id>`. Tag each one LabId=ul-04.
CMK key policy explicitly allows your lab principal kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt on that key only.
Default key administrators are not left as `*`.
One Secrets Manager secret stores a dummy value encrypted by the CMK; you record Secrets Manager pricing.
One SSM Parameter Store standard parameter exists; you record standard parameter pricing.
Secret and parameter are deleted before key schedule completes.
S3 test object uses SSE-KMS with the same CMK.
Key deletion remains scheduled and is not cancelled.
No secrets or parameters remain after teardown.
IAM users did not receive long-lived access keys.
Teardown order: secrets/parameters, S3, alias, key deletion window respected.

hints.text: Key policy JSON uses your account id and role/user Arn.
Secrets Manager charges per secret per month; delete same day.
Delete secret with force-delete-without-recovery when appropriate.

solution.outline: Key policy, Secrets Manager, SSM, and KMS teardown complete.

stopChargesPanel: Delete the secret and parameter, empty and delete the bucket, delete the alias, then schedule the CMK for deletion (7-day window) and do not cancel it.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-04
$KeyId = aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/workbook-ul04 --query KeyMetadata.KeyId --output text
# Force delete (no recovery window) so describe-secret returns ResourceNotFound, as the criteria require. The secret holds only a dummy value.
# The key stays PendingDeletion for 7 days. Do not cancel the deletion.
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-04 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION (the KMS key may still be listed while it is PendingDeletion)
aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id workbook-ul04-secret returns ResourceNotFoundException
aws ssm get-parameter --name workbook-ul04-param returns ParameterNotFound
aws kms describe-key --key-id $KeyId --query KeyMetadata.KeyState returns PendingDeletion
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-04 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-04. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-04) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
